kernel_patch.initial_q4_failure: Required 69632 bytes of workgroup memory, available 49152. The selector now reduces working units after register partitions reach one; packed weights remain packed.
kernel_patch.root_adoption: Embedding Cargo roots must adopt this patch to reproduce this qualified Q4 row.

limits: SmolLM2 native provider rows qualify these formats; larger quantized models were not measured in this gate.
Three fixed prompts measure execution and deviation, not general answer quality. CPU f16 and both quantized rows show answer drift from bf16.
The bf16 comparison across GPU rows includes backend arithmetic differences; supplemental errors compare against GPU f16.
Encoded payload and shared-plus-largest-layer counts exclude allocator overhead, activations, KV, temporary kernel buffers, library caches and import buffers.
Process peak working set covers the full fixture including import, diagnostics and pause/resume.
GPU memory sampling covers the entire GPU including unrelated processes, not isolated per-process VRAM.
Logical layer bytes include OS-cache hits; physical disk traffic and cold-disk throughput were not measured.
A compile-only Distillery build overlapped the measurements; elapsed costs are not an isolated throughput comparison.
The installed Djinn binary, a new headed browser row, physical second-device execution and Metal bf16 were not run in I7.

retained_outputs.reason: Unintegrated branch and subsequent I8 work; primary checkout has concurrent work.
Pinned model library, raw logits, measurements, failure evidence and logs for reproduction.
Stable reusable target and build directories; no isolated Cargo home was created.

native_source_note: The measurement executable was built from the working-tree content later committed as 963067cb, while Git HEAD still named d3365b49. The recorded source blob hashes identify that qualified content.
supplemental_source_note: The later guard admits arbitrary positive projection output widths while retaining K32 input alignment; it does not change the qualified aligned SmolLM2 encodings or arithmetic. The added 79-entry untied-head test covers this admission. Other changes are tests, headers, license provenance and the standalone patch gate lockfile.
format_guard_evidence_note: The bf16 baseline fixture rejects a candidate checkpoint after qualification changes its envelope. CPU bf16-to-f16 and every other native row-to-bf16 comparison exercise actual format changes.
